name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is a natural resource company focused on the exploration and development of gold deposits in the state of Nevada, USA. The company holds multiple gold projects including Loman, Agai-Pah, and Belshazzar, all located in Nevada — consistently rated among the world's top mining jurisdictions. Nevada Canyon is in the exploration stage, with recent reverse circulation drilling campaigns advancing its Nevada gold portfolio.
